title:
Epic used to handle user navigating away from cloning model workflow.
The epic handles the following cases:
1. On 'Reliability.ModelOperationsPageTitle.ACTIVE_TAB_SET', it gets the model id:
     - If model id is not defined: it opens exit modal, clears the application states, and redirects user to intended
         navigation page using {@link NavigationHelper#handleExitAnyway}.
     - If model id is defined:
         - starts listening to any GLOBAL_REDIRECT's happening and force redirects user back to cloning model page via
           a {@link NavigationHelper#handleForceBackRedirect}
         - opens exit modal.

2. On 'Reliability.CloningModelExitCloningModal.SECONDARY_BUTTON_CLICK':
     - fires 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' to page user originally intended to navigate to,
     - clears application states.
name: ExitCloningModelEpic
